summary: No findings. Hidden information: tableView (src/table/table-view.ts) reads table.hand only via playerView(table.hand, config.userSeat), whose fields are copied by name and carry no bot hole cards, deck or burns; it never reads table.replayCode. Table.tsx renders only SeatView/TableViewModel fields: bots get name, style, stack, street amount, action text, to-act badge, dealer marker and a small CardBack (data-card="back", aria-label "Face-down card") — no card identity in text, attributes, data-*, aria or title. data-to-act was removed; data-street and data-action-count are public. userActionBar(table) still takes the full TableState but is unchanged from the base and only feeds the user's own action bar. Verified by rendering every STORYBOARD_HISTORY state (preflop through showdown), SHOWDOWN and SEAT_1_DEALT with renderToStaticMarkup: the only face-up data-card values are the board and the user's two hole cards, and '9e3779b9' never appears. At showdown bots that are still in the hand show backs only; the current-hand PlayerView reveals nothing, so the UI shows nothing more. Production bundle: vite build into a scratch dir gives index.html, one JS, one CSS and the logo. There is no trace of table-scenes, table-scenarios, FLOP_BET, SEAT_1_DEALT, stubReplayWords or the harness titles. The only 0x9e3779b9 constant (2654435769) is the existing seeded-random.ts increment. The only fetch( is Vite's modulepreload polyfill (same-origin), and the https:// strings are React error-doc URLs. No src file imports tests/ or e2e/. No package.json/lockfile changes, so no new dependencies. No new randomness, storage, network or input boundaries. The scene harness's data-scene interpolation is test-only and typed to a literal union.
